items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the gentleman who was the drummer who worked with you when you were in the army... Billy Exner, yeah.

ctx.x: Well that’s the hippest thing that could happen to you, you know, is to wake up.

So, you know, during the night off, I wouldn’t consider it a night off, but the interim time between our sessions, I thought of a few things that we should go back and fill in for the historical record. First of all the gentleman who was the drummer who worked with you when you were in the army, we did go back and research and found that was William Exner.
